notes.title: In General Release
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody!

Since we have reached the official launch of the HTC Vive, we have put this app into general release.

This is of course more symbolic than functional, but it deserves an announcement anyway.

Congrats on the launch!

notes.title: Version 1.0.12 is out.
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, 

We've just released 1.0.12 to the pre-release community. 

This is our "Gold Master" which we expect to release very very soon!

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks to all our early adopters!
